{{Quote|A wall of light, created by many Jedi joined together, can push the darksiders back.|Arca Jeth|<ref name="DLOTSA" />}}
A '''wall of light''' was an immense [[Force power/Legends|manifestation]] of potentially destructive [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] [[The Force/Legends|Force energy]] created by the focused power of a united [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] front. When performed successfully, a wall of light allowed participants to effectively contain or purge the power of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] from a specific location, or [[Sever Force/Legends|sever]] an especially dangerous [[darksider]] from their Force connection. The ability was popular among [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]&ndash;era members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], who used it to great effect against the resurgent [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords]] of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] [[Brotherhood of the Sith|Sith Brotherhood]], and later against the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of Kun, by the inaugural class of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]].

==Description==
{{Quote|When you feel the dark side energies turned against you, you must use your Jedi abilities to take power away from an opponent, rather than to inflict harm. This technique blinds your enemy to the Force with a wall of light, a permanent blockage if you so choose, rendering him unable to use Jedi powers. It is difficult. And it is the most devastating attack possible using the powers of the light side.|Odan-Urr, via the Tedryn Holocron|<ref name="EGTTF" />}}
The use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to create a wall of [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side energy]] was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] most devastating offensive [[Force power/Legends|ability]].<ref name="EGTTF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> The technique required the collective effort of several participants<ref name="DLOTSA" /> to form&mdash;with considerable difficulty&mdash;an all-encompassing [[Prison/Legends|prison]] of [[blue]] energy, from which the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] could not escape. [[Planet/Legends|Celestial]] [[Moon/Legends|bodies]] besieged by a wall of light were sterilized<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> utterly with [[Fire/Legends|flames]] and violent weather phenomena,<ref name="TSW6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref> while [[Darksider|wielders of the dark side]] found themselves completely blocked from the Force.<ref name="EGTTF" />

==Applications==
{{Quote|We must create a wall of light&hellip;either to cleanse&hellip;or ''destroy''.|Nomi Sunrider|<ref name="TSW6" />}}
The primary purpose for the creation of a wall of light around a specific location was the quarantine or total eradication of the dark side's malevolent influence.<ref name="TSW6" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] also used walls of light to harmlessly<ref name="EGTTF" /> subdue<ref name="TSW2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 2]]</ref> or repel<ref name="DLOTSA" /> extremely dangerous enemies.<ref name="TSW2" /> Under dire circumstances, however, a lone Jedi was able to channel the light side of the Force to offensively incapacitate a foe,<ref name="TSW5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 5]]</ref> but use of such power often brought forth unexpected and potentially catastrophic results. The victim of a wall of light experienced extreme agony<ref name="TSW6" /> as their connection to the Force was interrupted in a [[Sever Force/Legends|severance]] that could be made permanent at the discretion of the Jedi.<ref name="EGTTF" /> Walls of light were also an effective weapon against Sith [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]].<ref name="COTF" />

==Users==
{{Quote|The way to extinguish a shadow, is to increase the light.|Cilghal|<ref name="COTF" />}}
[[File:Kun_vs_Wall_of_Light.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Exar Kun is humbled by the Jedi's creation of a wall of light.]]
[[Draethos]] Jedi Knight [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] used a wall of light to disconnect [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] defeated [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] warriors from the Force in the final stages of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="TSW1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 1]]</ref> He later recorded a detailed account of the ability in the [[Tedryn Holocron]].<ref name="EGTTF" /> More than a [[3996 BBY|thousand years after]] the Hyperspace War,<ref name="TSW1" /> Odan-Urr taught a prodigious Jedi Knight named [[Nomi Sunrider]] to utilize walls of light in the harmless incapacitation of enemies.<ref name="TSW6" /> During the Jedi [[Conclave at Deneba|conclave]] on [[Deneba/Legends|Deneba]], [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]] inferred that a wall of light was required to drive away the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]],<ref name="DLOTSA" /> whose [[Krath Holy Crusade|holy crusade]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]<ref name="DLOTS2">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 2]]</ref> had spread the influence of the dark side across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> When the Krath later [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Sith War)|attacked]] the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], their leader, [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]]&ndash;turned&ndash;Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], was defeated and trapped within a wall of light by Masters [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]] and [[Thon]], who were assisted by Knights [[Tott Doneeta]], [[Cay Qel-Droma]], Nomi Sunrider,<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> [[Dace Diath]], and [[Sylvar]].<ref name="TSW2" />

Nomi Sunrider [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|faced]] Qel-Droma again on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and imprisoned him within a wall of light<ref name="TSW5" /> that inadvertently resulted in Qel-Droma's permanent severance from the Force.<ref name="TSW6" /> At the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Great Sith War)|culmination]] of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], Sunrider guided thousands of Jedi,<ref name="Numbers">In the scene of [[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]] that depicts the implementation of ''wall of light'', the narration states that "thousands upon thousands of Force wielders" participated.</ref> including Tott Doneeta, Sylvar, [[Oss Wilum]], and Thon, in the creation of a wall of light over the [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin moon]] to defeat [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]. Although his [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] had been successfully trapped within the walls of his [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] [[Temple of Exar Kun|temple]], a planet-wide firestorm caused by the Jedi's magnified power annihilated Yavin 4's landscape in the process.<ref name="TSW6" /> More than [[11 ABY/Legends|four thousand years]] later, Kun's ghost was forever cleansed from Yavin 4 through the creation of a wall of light initiated by the trainees of Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]].<ref name="COTF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wall of light was first mentioned in [[Tom Veitch]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]]'s [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 3|''Descent to the Dark Side'']], the third issue in the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - Dark Lords of the Sith'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] story arc. Wall of light's first appearance was in [[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 2|''The Battle of Coruscant'']], the second issue of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Tales of the Jedi''{{'s}}]] subsequent [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War|''Sith War'']] story arc. It was also featured as the means by which the Jedi and Republic defeated Exar Kun in ''The Sith War''{{'s}} final issue, titled [[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Dark Lord'']]. While ''The Sith War 6: Dark Lord'' depicts the destruction of Yavin 4's landscape as the result of the Jedi's creation of a wall of light, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' states incorrectly that the moon's surface was destroyed by [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]].

In the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', one of the servers is named after this Force technique.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
